name: Booker Vineyard / My Favorite Neighbor - Paso Robles CA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Driveway entrance off Anderson Road has a low decorative metal arch / cattle-grate gate frame, not a barrier arm or a controlled checkpoint that closes the truck lane. Wire stock fencing along the property line. Treated as open estate access — truckGate false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the entrance. Estate-style entry with decorative metalwork only.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long winding driveway from Anderson Road through olive trees and vineyard up to the production buildings — easily holds a 3+ vehicle queue.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Small estate winery — production complex of a long solar-roofed winery building plus a red-roof building, with clustered white wine tanks. No bank of dedicated freight dock doors; ~2 at-grade roll-up/service doors estimated. Low confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No marked trailer-parking stalls with parked trailers. A row of staged white tanks/bins sits along the upper driveway, but that is production storage, not a trailer drop area.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Three distinct structures: the main winery/barrel building, an adjacent red-roof production building, and the hospitality/tasting building to the east.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Paso Robles westside wine country — winery surrounded by estate vineyards and olive groves, far from any dense urban fabric.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural but within the well-developed Paso Robles wine region; cellular coverage likely adequate. Marked uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail anywhere near the property.
